name: Massive Collapse
description:
About This Game

Massive Collapse is an 8v8, round-based tactical shooter where every match lets you build a new way to play. Choose one of four distinct races, then mix and match weapons, spells, and gadgets to create powerful combinations, exploit meaningful tradeoffs, and outplay the opposing team.

CHOOSE YOUR RACE

Four races. Four ways to fight. Select from Human, Elf, Orc, or Siphon, each with distinct mechanics, playstyles, and relationships to Aether. Your race defines how you move, how you engage, and how you bend the rules of the battlefield. Choose wisely. Your bloodline is your foundation for battle.

CAST POWERFUL SPELLS

Gunplay alone won't win rounds. Every race has access to a full spectrum of abilities spanning arcane magic to cutting-edge technology, and how you combine them is what separates good players from great ones. Build your loadout, read the round, and master the use of Aether to create a playstyle that's entirely your own. 

CONTROL UNIQUE GADGETS

Every gadget is available to every race. Use advanced technology to gather information, control space, support your team, or disrupt the enemy. Pair gadgets with your race and spells to create combinations your opponents may never see coming.

WIELD DIFFERENT WEAPONS

Every race can wield every weapon, but strength and weight shape the tradeoff. Heavy weapons deliver devastating firepower but may slow less powerful races, while lighter weapons preserve speed and mobility. Choose the weapon that completes your build.

DESIGN YOUR PLAYSTYLE

Your race is only the beginning. Your weapon, spells, and gadgets determine how the complete build comes together. Experiment with new combinations every match, adapt between battles, and discover your own ways to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm the opposing team.
short_desc: Massive Collapse is a round-based multiplayer shooter where every match begins with a new build. Choose your race, combine spells and gadgets to create new strategies built to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm your opponents.
